{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 (since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
data['biomarker_final'] = data.apply(lambda row: row['biomarker_final'] / 10 if row['assay_batch'] == 'B' else row['biomarker_final'], axis=1)

# Final data shape after cleaning
data.shape"}
